decision: Accepted as the primary Host and Admin use-case views at business-goal level. No requirement to add include or extend to every diagram.
scope: Diagram/source/permission audit, not a new runtime acceptance test.

relationshipDecision.association: Actor participation; no process ordering implied.
relationshipDecision.hostGeneralization: Host inherits shared renter goals on overview.
relationshipDecision.include: Calendar release can remain in use-case specifications and workflow. No added support ellipse needed at this level.
relationshipDecision.extend: Do not connect combined suspend/unsuspend or block/unblock use cases to report handling; reports only invoke the restrictive action.

verifiedConstraints: Host cancellation has a reason and occurs before rental start.
NO_SHOW is after endAt and requires a reason.
Admin blocked-Host handling is per booking.
Admin usage correction is not always limited to blocked Hosts.
Unsuspending a room returns INACTIVE; Host must reopen ACTIVE.
Host statistics are room/request counts, not a revenue ledger.
